derivation: a primitive root; to clip off; used only as denominative from H7019 (קַיִץ);

occurrences.text: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
